title: Ledger 4 — Knowledge exchange (who told whom; were they allowed?)
description: arch §5 L4: every inter-agent transfer — content, source→recipient principals, disclosure policy applied, lineage to origin. Payloads referenced, not copied, where sensitive (§5 minimization). Fork: written only at FK7+ (A2A beyond two hand-configured peers is deferred); schema extracted now so nothing needs revalidating at merge-back.

content_ref.description: The transferred content, by reference where sensitive

source_principal.description: Principal whose agent sent the knowledge

disclosure_policy.description: The disclosure policy applied to permit the transfer (arch §3.2.3)

origin_lineage.description: Lineage chain back to the content's origin (L3 target ids)

taint_mark.description: Taint tier carried to the receiver (arch §7.7: cross-agent taint via L4)
